answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the karst bond on all of them and exposing each to the signal slash. Because the knoll audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
